CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ecb7.retain(k text, c uuid, j jsonb, i uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid())
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ begin
 insert into public.artifacts(id,artifact_role,context_id,payload_text) values(i,k,c,j::text); return i;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ecb8.ack(s uuid, a uuid, start_id uuid, reported_terminal uuid, received boolean, p uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare h jsonb; begin
 perform ecb8.lock_scope(s); h:=ecb8.history(s,a); perform ecb8.expected(h,p);
 if not(h->'starts' ? start_id::text) then raise exception 'b8_ack_start_required'; end if;
 return ecb8.event(s,a,h,'ack',jsonb_build_object('start',start_id,'reported_terminal',reported_terminal,'received',received),gen_random_uuid());
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ecb8.expected(h jsonb, p uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ begin
 if h->>'head' is distinct from p::text then raise exception 'b8_stale_predecessor'; end if;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ecb8.fixture_event(s uuid, a uuid, k text, d jsonb, p uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare h jsonb; eid uuid; begin
 if k not in ('tick','ready','dependency','revoke_grant','withdraw') then raise exception 'b8_fixture_event_kind'; end if;
 perform ecb8.lock_scope(s); h:=ecb8.history(s,a); perform ecb8.expected(h,p);
 eid:=ecb8.event(s,a,h,k,d,gen_random_uuid()); perform ecb8.history(s,a); return eid;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ecb8.keys(j jsonb, names text[])
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare actual text[]; expected text[]; begin
 select array_agg(k order by k) into actual from jsonb_object_keys(j) k;
 select array_agg(k order by k) into expected from unnest(names) k;
 if actual is distinct from expected then raise exception 'b8_exact_fields:%',names; end if;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ecb8.observation(h jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('value',h->'value','revision',h->'revision','ready',h->'ready','tick',h->'tick',
 'dependencies',h->'dependencies','orientation',(select current_event from ecb7.scopes where id=(h->'initial'->>'scope')::uuid));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ecb8.retain(k text, c uuid, bytes text, i uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid())
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ begin
 insert into public.artifacts(id,artifact_role,context_id,payload_text) values(i,k,c,bytes); return i;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ecb_governance.check_setup(s ecb_governance.scopes, secret text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if secret is null or ecb_governance.hash(secret)<>s.setup_hash or s.setup_expires<=clock_timestamp() or s.binding is not null or s.current_transition is not null then raise exception 'setup_unavailable'; end if;
 if s.created_xid=pg_current_xact_id() then raise exception 'prior_commit_required'; end if;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ecb_governance.hash(t text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ select pg_catalog.encode(pg_catalog.sha256(pg_catalog.convert_to(t,'UTF8')),'hex') $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ecb_governance.identity()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare r uuid := pg_catalog.gen_random_uuid(); begin insert into public.referents(id) values(r); return r; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ecb_governance.immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin raise exception 'immutable_history'; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ecb_governance.policy(p text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare j jsonb; template jsonb := '{
  "format": "ecb.build6.policy.v1",
  "operation": "policy_succession",
  "authorizer": "current_designated_h_in_scope",
  "requires_prior_committed_exact_decision": true,
  "requires_expected_current_predecessor": true,
  "requires_unwithdrawn_decision": true,
  "requires_human_explanation": false,
  "preserves": [
    "governance_scope",
    "initial_h_designation_and_remit",
    "prior_authority_history",
    "bootstrap_exhaustion"
  ],
  "pending_decision_withdrawal": "issuing_h_only",
  "allows_delegation": false,
  "allows_other_operations": false
}
'::jsonb; begin
 if p is null or octet_length(p)>32768 or not(p is json object with unique keys) then raise exception 'unsupported_policy'; end if;
 j:=p::jsonb;
 if jsonb_typeof(j->'requires_human_explanation') is distinct from 'boolean'
 or (j-'requires_human_explanation') is distinct from (template-'requires_human_explanation') then raise exception 'unsupported_policy'; end if;
 return j;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ecb_governance.register_identity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin insert into public.referents(id) values(new.id); return new; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ecb_governance.retain(k text, p text, s text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare r uuid; begin
 if k='policy' then perform ecb_governance.policy(p); end if;
 insert into ecb_governance.subjects(kind,payload,source) values(k,p,s) returning id into r; return r;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ecb_governance.view_scope(scope_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('scope',to_jsonb(s)-'setup_hash','subjects',
 (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)),'[]') from ecb_governance.subjects x where x.id in(s.p0,s.remit,s.root_basis,s.binding) or x.id in(select policy from ecb_governance.decisions where scope=s.id)),
 'credentials',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) order by c.id),'[]') from ecb_governance.credentials c where c.scope=s.id),
 'decisions',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d) order by d.id),'[]') from ecb_governance.decisions d where d.scope=s.id),
 'transitions',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by t.id),'[]') from ecb_governance.transitions t where t.scope=s.id))
 from ecb_governance.scopes s where s.id=scope_id
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.register_thought_referent()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.referents (id)
  values (new.id);

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reject_build_5b_artifact_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  raise exception 'BUILD 5B Artifacts are immutable; % is not permitted', tg_op
    using errcode = '42501';
  return null;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_thoughts(query_embedding extensions.vector, match_count integer DEFAULT 10)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, content text, source text, captured_at timestamp with time zone, embedding_model text, similarity double precision)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select
    thought.id,
    thought.content,
    thought.source,
    thought.captured_at,
    thought.embedding_model,
    1 - (
      thought.embedding operator(extensions.<=>) query_embedding
    ) as similarity
  from public.thoughts as thought
  order by
    thought.embedding operator(extensions.<=>) query_embedding,
    thought.id
  limit least(greatest(coalesce(match_count, 10), 1), 100);
$function$

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER claim_standing_transitions_prepare BEFORE INSERT ON public.claim_standing_transitions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prepare_claim_standing_transition()
CREATE TRIGGER claims_prepare BEFORE INSERT ON public.claims FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prepare_claim()
CREATE TRIGGER evidence_links_prepare BEFORE INSERT ON public.evidence_links FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prepare_evidence_link()
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_history BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE OR TRUNCATE ON ecb_governance.subjects FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION ecb_governance.immutable()
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_history BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE OR TRUNCATE ON ecb_governance.decisions FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION ecb_governance.immutable()
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_history BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE OR TRUNCATE ON ecb_governance.transitions FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION ecb_governance.immutable()
CREATE TRIGGER prepare_build7_artifact BEFORE INSERT ON public.artifacts FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((new.artifact_role ~~ 'b7_%'::text)) EXECUTE FUNCTION ecb7.prepare_artifact()

CREATE TRIGGER prepare_build8_artifact BEFORE INSERT ON public.artifacts FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((new.artifact_role = ANY (ARRAY['b8_basis'::text, 'b8_envelope'::text, 'b8_evaluation'::text, 'b8_event'::text]))) EXECUTE FUNCTION ecb8.prepare_artifact()

CREATE TRIGGER prepare_build9_artifact BEFORE INSERT ON public.artifacts FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((new.artifact_role = ANY (ARRAY['b9_basis'::text, 'b9_inquiry'::text, 'b9_event'::text, 'b9_judgment'::text]))) EXECUTE FUNCTION ecb9.prepare()

CREATE TRIGGER prepare_build_5b_artifact BEFORE INSERT ON public.artifacts FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((new.artifact_role = ANY (ARRAY['source_representation'::text, 'transformation_request'::text, 'transformed_representation'::text, 'check_attempt'::text, 'transformation_receipt'::text]))) EXECUTE FUNCTION prepare_build_5b_artifact()
CREATE TRIGGER register_identity BEFORE INSERT ON ecb_governance.sessions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ecb_governance.register_identity()

CREATE TRIGGER register_identity BEFORE INSERT ON ecb_governance.ceremonies FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ecb_governance.register_identity()
CREATE TRIGGER register_identity BEFORE INSERT ON ecb_governance.decisions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ecb_governance.register_identity()
CREATE TRIGGER register_identity BEFORE INSERT ON ecb_governance.transitions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ecb_governance.register_identity()
CREATE TRIGGER reject_build_5b_artifact_mutation BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE OR TRUNCATE ON public.artifacts FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_build_5b_artifact_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER thoughts_register_referent BEFORE INSERT ON public.thoughts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION register_thought_referent()
